sentences.text: Aaron Charles Carter -LRB- born December 7 , 1987 -RRB- is an American singer .

He came to fame as a pop and hip hop singer in the late 1990s , establishing himself as a star among pre-teen and teenage audiences during the early 2000s with his four studio albums .	hip hop	Hip hop music	pre-teen	Preadolescence	teenage	teenage
